notes.title: Hotfix 1.22
notes.content:
We just released a hotfix for 3:21 which solves an issue with achievements not being unlocked properly in some rare cases. 

Also the achievement "The End Brings New Beginnings" has been moved [spoiler] to the game's real ending instead of triggering in the dark bedroom area.[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 1.21
notes.content:
We just pushed patch 1.21 - this one includes various bug fixes and enables DLC content for all of our supporters. See below for a full list of our patch notes.

- added DLC content for Windows+Mac
- fixed a bug that could have caused you to get stuck in the bedroom
- removed vsync option from settingsmenu for now and enabled by default
- fixed spelling error in loading screen
- fixed door sounds randomly appearing ingame
- fixed light switch being accessible from outside the classroom
- fixed control error after Into The Light
- fixed sound issue during bedroom minigame
- fixed elevator that appeared to be still open in some situations
- fixed normal maps on some objects that had caused graphical issues
- fixed end house swing minigame textures

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Save the Game
notes.content:
This patch brings you the most requested features: Save files and better performance optimization ! 


A list of complete patch notes can be found below:


1.1 - Save the Game
- new: Save files (the game will now save at specific points during the story automatically so whenever you have beaten one part of the game then a little save icon will appear in the bottom right corner)
- fix: performance optimizations 
- new: Blur graphic option added (disabled by default)
- fix: disabled minigame in the office for now
- fix: fixed a rare bug that could cause you to take multiple oars from one location in "sweden" [spoiler] bedroom minigame	[/spoiler]
- fix: fixed a collider issue in the cabin area which could have caused you to get stuck
- new: SPRINT option, hold down SHIFT key to move faster
- fix: CrashCoders can be started by pressing any key
- fix: fixed an issue with normal maps in general
- new: added version Info and help text on loading screen
- and various smaller adjustements have been made

The patch should be available in the next minutes on Windows and Mac
